# Cabo Verde (CPV) — sub-national homicide

## Found
- INE-CV publishes Polícia Nacional occurrences by type and island for every year 2010-2022 (XLS, one sheet per year). The homicide row is labelled "Homicício, PN" (typo in source for Homicídio; "PN" = Polícia Nacional). Nine islands + national total; all 13 years extracted (130 rows).
- INE-CV "Cabo Verde, Justiça e Segurança em números – 2015" (published March 2017) has concelho-level tables for 2014 and 2015 (22 concelhos). Both extracted (46 rows). Many concelho cells are suppressed as "…" (confidential) — 9 of 22 in 2014, 10 of 22 in 2015 — and are left blank with a note.
- Definition in the 2015 publication (p. 19): "É considerado homicídio o acto consumado de tirar a vida a alguém, sem tipificar se é homicídio simples, negligente ou agravado. Nessa perspectiva o acto tentado não é contabilizado." (My rendering: homicide = the completed act of taking a life, whether simple, negligent or aggravated; attempts are not counted.) So the series includes negligent homicide, i.e. it is wider than UNODC "intentional homicide".

## Gaps / problems
- Nothing by island or concelho after 2022 was found. The INE "Anuário Estatístico" (2015-2023 editions, found via the same data service) has no justice/crime chapter (confirmed for the 2022 edition: chapters cover territory, population, health, education, economy, trade, agriculture, environment, energy, political participation only).
- No concelho breakdown for years other than 2014-2015. Concelho = municipality (22 at the time).
- Polícia Nacional website (policianacional.cv) returned a 358-byte placeholder page; no annual report found online.
- Health route: INE "Estatísticas Vitais" reports give deaths by concelho but not by cause. The Ministério da Saúde "Relatório Estatístico" (2016, 2018 editions on the WHO AHO mirror) has "Tabela 28 - Total de óbitos segundo causas por concelho de residência", but the mirror (files.aho.afro.who.int) is blocked for direct download in this environment and the web reader truncates the PDF before page 46, so the table could not be read; the minsaude.gov.cv download links (/download/114/relatorio-estatistico/...) return 404. Whether that table has an "agressões" column is unverified.
- Licence: none stated; INE copyright notice only.
- The ine.cv website is a JavaScript app: the file URLs above are served from bdmi.ine.cv and could change if INE re-uploads.

## Other content in the sources
- Full crime-type-by-island matrix 2010-2022 (ofensas corporais, VBG, roubo, furto, droga, armas, etc.).
- Monthly occurrences 2010-2022 (separate XLS, national).
- 2015 publication: offenders and victims by sex/age/concelho, courts and prosecution caseloads, border movements, road accidents.
